task: Diagnosed and fixed 79 backend test failures across auth, projects, schema, and webhook routes by resolving event loop scope mismatches, asyncpg pool lifecycle issues, Pydantic v2 Record serialization, FastAPI redirect_slashes behavior, and FK constraint violations in test fixtures.
discussion_summary: Session 1 established the 10-day build plan with pgvector, WorkOS, and 8 external services. This session inherited a backend test suite with 79 failures stemming from three root causes: (1) asyncpg session-scoped pool used across different event loops in pytest, (2) FastAPI's default redirect_slashes=True causing 307 redirects on untrailed routes, (3) Pydantic v2 unable to deserialize asyncpg Records directly without dict() conversion. Fixes included pytest.ini asyncio scope configuration, FastAPI app instantiation with redirect_slashes=False, service layer dict() wrapping, and test fixture teardown ordering to respect FK constraints. All 79 tests now pass.

accomplishments.what: Fixed asyncpg event loop scope mismatch: added asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = session and asyncio_default_test_loop_scope = session to pytest.ini to share pool across all tests
Fixed FastAPI redirect_slashes behavior: set redirect_slashes=False on FastAPI() app instantiation to prevent 307 redirects on /projects, /analyses, /notifications routes
Fixed Pydantic v2 Record deserialization: wrapped all asyncpg query results with dict(row) in projects.py service layer before returning to route handlers
Fixed test fixture FK constraint violations: reordered investor fixture teardown to delete projects before users, preventing cascade delete errors
Fixed test_super_admin_can_access_admin_invite_route: created real project in test before sending invite to avoid FK violation on non-existent project_id
Fixed SQL syntax error in test_analyses_unique_per_project_stage: corrected ':jsonb' to '::jsonb' cast operator
Fixed test_list_projects_only_returns_users_own_projects: added project deletion before user deletion in inline cleanup to respect FK constraints
Fixed webhook handler error response: changed admin.py invite endpoint to return 422 for malformed payload instead of 500
Reduced test failures from 79 to 0: all backend unit and integration tests now passing

decisions.decision: Use pgvector on Supabase instead of Neo4j for knowledge graph storage
decisions.reason: Eliminates a separate service, guarantees project isolation via FK constraints, HNSW index is fast enough for syndicate scale, simplifies deployment and cost

decisions.decision: Replace custom auth system with WorkOS AuthKit
decisions.reason: Removes password reset, TOTP enrollment, invite token management, and session management from scope; WorkOS handles MFA, invitations, and user lifecycle end-to-end

decisions.decision: [SUPERSEDED] Extend build timeline from 7 days to 10 days
decisions.reason: Realistic integration complexity, service setup overhead, and UI iteration rounds require buffer; MVP still ships in 4-5 weeks, production in 6-7 weeks

decisions.decision: Compress build timeline from 10 days to 8 days by merging Days 8/9/10 into single integration/deployment sprint
decisions.reason: Voice input, admin UI, wiring mocks, E2E testing, and production deploy can be parallelized; MVP still ships in 4-5 weeks, production in 6-7 weeks

decisions.decision: Disable Supabase RLS and enforce access control in FastAPI instead
decisions.reason: WorkOS issues JWTs, not Supabase Auth tokens; FastAPI is the only DB client and has full context of user identity and role; cleaner than filtering every query

decisions.decision: Use Serper free tier for competitive scan (deferred to Day 5)
decisions.reason: Free tier covers MVP scale; can upgrade to paid if volume exceeds limits

decisions.decision: Defer voice input (Whisper + MediaRecorder) to post-MVP
decisions.reason: Non-critical path; text-only chat is sufficient for MVP; voice adds UI complexity without blocking core flow

decisions.decision: Defer admin user management UI, audit log viewer, and prompt editor UI to post-MVP
decisions.reason: Can manage users via Supabase dashboard and WorkOS console; internal tools can be added after MVP

decisions.decision: Set FastAPI app with redirect_slashes=False to prevent 307 redirects on untrailed routes
decisions.reason: Tests expect exact route matching; default redirect_slashes=True causes 307 on /projects, /analyses, /notifications

decisions.decision: Wrap all asyncpg query results with dict(row) in service layer before returning to route handlers
decisions.reason: Pydantic v2 cannot deserialize asyncpg Records directly; dict() conversion ensures proper JSON serialization

decisions.decision: Use session-scoped asyncpg pool with asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = session in pytest.ini
decisions.reason: Prevents event loop scope mismatch when session-scoped fixtures are used across function-scoped tests

decisions.decision: Reorder test fixture teardown to delete projects before users to respect FK constraints
decisions.reason: FK constraint on projects.user_id prevents user deletion if projects still exist; proper teardown order prevents cascade delete errors

behavioral_preferences.rule: Provide realistic time estimates backed by service setup overhead and integration complexity; avoid inflated timelines
When architecture changes significantly (e.g., Neo4j → pgvector, custom auth → WorkOS), update all affected LLD files immediately and regenerate build plan
Use imperative, direct language in handovers and build plans; avoid hedging or tentative phrasing
